subhead: From business planning to operations, I have delivered at every stage of the AI lifecycle.

sdlc.title: AI SDLC: where each project sits in the lifecycle
sdlc.note: A bar spans the stages that the project covers. Click a bar to see the project.

stages.name: Business Planning
stages.desc: Define use case, value, cost, and rules: is it worth it, and how to measure it.

stages.name: Model Tuning
stages.desc: Data, prompts, evaluation, and red teaming: make the model correct and safe.

stages.name: Development & Deployment
stages.desc: Select the platform, integrate systems, launch: turn the plan into a service.

stages.name: Operations & Monitoring
stages.desc: AI operations platform, monitoring, and adoption: keep it running and get people to use it.

governance.name: AI governance (across the full lifecycle)
governance.desc: Set the rules in planning, check at every stage, and track in operations.
